title: Asiad: Gilas Men 3x3 succumb to red-hot Korea, set for bronze-medal bout
summary: Gilas Pilipinas Men succumbed to South Korea in the semifinals of the 3-on-3 basketball tournament of the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games at the Kinjo Futo Station Square Venue in Japan on Friday.
